art_direction: 珊瑚郁金香 · 温柔绅士: 墨绿底，珊瑚粉三瓣花冠与短叶领口，细长眼睛神态温和。
composition_variation: A single coral-pink tulip blossom as a poised little character, on a smooth very dark forest-green field. The flower has an elegant compact cup silhouette whose top edge makes three rounded petal peaks, not spiky zigzags. Two short fresh sage-green leaves rise from a tiny stem below like a tasteful collar; attached to the same flower, not a bouquet. Two delicate dark half-lidded almond eyes and a minute mouth on the coral blossom create a warm polite expression. The whole character tilts just slightly. Shape fills about 52 percent width and 66 percent height. Only coral, dark green and sage with at most one off-white eye glint. No pot, extra flowers, veins, petal shading or decorative objects. A beautifully balanced imaginative botanical avatar.
